title: Naver mail compose SPA read via CDP fiber
desc: Reading Naver mail compose editor content via CDP in React SPA. Use eval-js to access React fiber internals for editor state.
steps: Naver mail is a React SPA. DOM text nodes do not reflect editor state directly -- use CDP eval-js to read React fiber props.
Target the compose editor container via CSS selector, then access .__reactFiber or stateNode to get current editor content.
Fallback: if React fiber unavailable, use window.getSelection() or the contenteditable innerText.
author: claude
